title: 大语言模型思维链推理的均场动力学
summary: 本文提出一个框架，在不简化模型架构或类比物理系统的情况下，为LLM思维链推理提供统计规律和理论解释。将推理视为线索图上的引导发现过程，利用均场近似推导出已发现线索比例的一维常微分方程。实验通过学生模型对教师模型输出的归一化惊讶度识别线索，验证了统计规律的可复现性及理论方程的拟合效果。
summary_en: This paper introduces a framework for statistical regularities and theoretical interpretations of LLM chain-of-thought reasoning without simplifying architecture or physical analogies. It models reasoning as guided discovery on a clue graph and derives a one-dimensional ODE for discovered clue fraction via mean-field approximation. Experiments using normalized surprisal confirm reproducibility and fit.
